kaps_punt: Belangrikste minerale wat in Suid-Afrika ontgin word en hul gebruike - insluitende goud, platinum, diamante, ystererts, chroom, koper, silwer en mangaan

items.bewering: 'n Mes, 'n koperdraad en 'n trouring is gemaak van stowwe wat mense uit die grond haal.
items.blok: Van die grond tot in jou huis
items.bron: Steel comes from iron ore, and 98% of mined iron ore goes to steel (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iron_ore). Copper is the main wire metal (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copper). Gold, platinum and silver are mined metals used in jewellery (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold).

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika haal baie sulke stowwe uit sy grond. Hier is agt van die belangrikste.
items.blok: Van die grond tot in jou huis
items.bron: Silver: South Africa mined about 59 t in 2023, against a world total of about 25 800 t, with no primary silver mine; it is recovered as a by-product of gold mining (Sibanye-Stillwater CEO, https://newsletter.en.creamermedia.com/article/silver-is-smart-metal-that-fits-sibanye-stillwaters-green-space-froneman-2021-03-31) and of zinc-lead-copper mining at Black Mountain (https://miningdataonline.com/property/3169/Black-Mountain-Mine.aspx). Production figure: https://www.indexmundi.com/en/commodities/minerals/silver/silver_t8.html. The Minerals Council puts silver in an 'other metallic minerals' group with cobalt, lead, titanium and zinc (https://polity.org.za/article/other-metallic-minerals-south-african-minings-outstanding-2025-performers-2026-02-16), while the major commodities by sales are PGMs, coal, gold and iron ore (https://www.mineralscouncil.org.za/industry-news/publications/facts-and-figures/send/17-facts-and-figures/143-facts-and-figures-2012), and chrome, manganese and diamonds also lead world output (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining_in_South_Africa). Copper output is also modest now (Palabora about 15 kt in 2023, https://www.globaldata.com/data-insights/mining/south-africa--five-largest-copper-mines-in-2090872/).
items.regstelling: Six of the eight are among South Africa's most important mining products: gold, platinum, diamonds, iron ore, chrome and manganese. Silver is not, on any measure of South African mining: by value, by tonnage or by world share. Copper is a weak case too. Coal, vanadium, titanium and zinc all rank above silver in South African mining. Soften the sentence so it no longer ranks all eight as 'of the most important'. One option is 'Hier is agt belangrike minerale wat ons uit die grond haal'; another is to introduce them as eight minerals that South Africa mines. The lesson's own later sentence, that silver comes out mostly together with other metals, is true and supports this. Do not cut silver: the lesson is about all eight.

items.bewering: Goud is 'n kosbare geel metaal waarvan mense ringe en ander juweliersware maak.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold. Jewellery is gold's largest use; the metal is yellow and precious.

items.bewering: Goud gelei elektrisiteit goed, en dit roes nie soos yster nie.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold: 'conductivity of electricity'; 'Gold does not react with oxygen at any temperature'. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rust: rust means iron oxide, and iron in water and oxygen forms rust over time. The comparison with iron holds.

items.bewering: Daarom is daar klein bietjies goud binne-in selfone en rekenaars.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold: 'corrosion-resistant electrical connectors in all types of computerized devices', its chief industrial use. A smartphone holds about 0.035 g of gold, according to the Royal Mint (https://www.itpro.com/technology/361321/royal-mint-recover-gold-smartphones-laptops-world-first). The word 'daarom' is right: conductivity together with corrosion resistance is the stated reason.

items.bewering: 'n Tandarts gebruik soms goud om tande te herstel.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold lists 'tooth restoration' among gold's uses. Dental gold alloys run about 75% gold (https://www.bullionbypost.co.uk/index/gold/uses-of-gold/). 'Soms' is accurate.

items.bewering: Platinum is 'n silwerwit metaal vir juweliersware en vir party dinge wat dokters gebruik.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platinum: 'silver-white metal'; used in jewellery; cisplatin and related chemotherapy drugs; medical instruments. Most pacemakers have platinum-iridium electrodes, and platinum is also in catheters and guide wires (https://www.thermofisher.com/blog/metals/could-platinum-group-metals-save-your-life).

items.bewering: In motors help platinum om die uitlaatgasse minder skadelik te maak.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platinum: vehicle emissions control devices were platinum's largest single use (45% in 2014); in catalytic converters it completes the combustion of unburned hydrocarbons in the exhaust.

items.bewering: Silwer is 'n blink metaal vir juweliersware, elektroniese toestelle en party dinge wat dokters gebruik.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silver: 'brilliant, white, metallic lustre'; jewellery; electrical contacts and conductors; antimicrobial materials. Silver Institute: silver is used in wound and burn treatment (https://silverinstitute.org/?p=6276).

items.bewering: In Suid-Afrika word silwer meestal saam met ander metale uit die grond gehaal.
items.bron: Sibanye-Stillwater's CEO says that in South Africa silver is a by-product of gold (https://newsletter.en.creamermedia.com/article/silver-is-smart-metal-that-fits-sibanye-stillwaters-green-space-froneman-2021-03-31). At Black Mountain, Aggeneys, both the Deeps and Swartberg units produce silver as a by-product of copper, lead and zinc (https://miningdataonline.com/property/3169/Black-Mountain-Mine.aspx; https://vedanta-zincinternational.com/what-we-do/our-operations/black-mountain-mining/). Worldwide, most silver comes as a by-product of lead-zinc, copper and gold mining (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silver).

items.bewering: Diamante is minerale wat so hard is dat byna niks 'n krap op hulle kan maak nie.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diamond: 'the hardest material on the qualitative Mohs scale'; 'the hardest diamonds can only be scratched by other diamonds'. The superlative is implicit, and 'byna niks' states it correctly. Diamond is a mineral (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mineral).

items.bewering: Mooi diamante word as blink klippe in ringe en ander juweliersware gebruik.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diamond: diamond is 'the preferred gem in engagement or wedding rings'.

items.bewering: Klein stukkies diamant sit ook op gereedskap wat klip en glas sny of in rots boor.
items.bron: Britannica on industrial diamonds (https://www.britannica.com/print/article/287017): rock-coring drills set with diamonds around the rim of the drill crown; saws for cutting rock; glass cutters. Diamond saws cut marble and granite blocks (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diamond_tool).

items.bewering: Ystererts is die gesteente waaruit ons yster kry.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iron_ore: iron ores are 'rocks and minerals from which metallic iron can be economically extracted'.

items.bewering: Van yster maak mense staal wat sterker is as yster alleen.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steel: steel is 'an alloy of iron and carbon that demonstrates improved mechanical properties compared to the pure form of iron'.

items.bewering: Staal word gebruik om geboue, brûe, voertuie en masjiene te bou.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steel lists buildings, bridges, infrastructure, car bodies, machines, ships and tools.

items.bewering: Mangaan help om staal te maak en maak die staal nog sterker.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manganese: manganese is 'essential to iron and steel production by virtue of its sulfur-fixing, deoxidizing, and alloying properties'. Steelmaking takes 85-90% of demand. As an alloying element it adds strength and hardness.

items.bewering: Mangaan word ook in sekere batterye gebruik.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manganese: manganese dioxide in carbon-zinc and alkaline cells. Lithium-ion cathodes LMO, NMC and LMFP contain manganese (https://www.batterydesign.net/chemistry/lithium-ion-chemistry/). 'Sekere' is accurate.

items.bewering: Gewone staal begin roes as dit lank nat bly.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rust: 'Given sufficient time, any iron mass in the presence of water and oxygen will form rust'. Carbon steel is less corrosion-resistant than stainless steel and is often galvanised against rust (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steel).

items.bewering: Chroom word by staal gevoeg om vlekvrye staal te maak. Vlekvrye staal roes nie maklik nie.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stainless_steel: its corrosion resistance comes from a 'chromium content of 10.5% or more', which forms a passive chromium-oxide film. It is 'not completely immune to corrosion', so 'nie maklik nie' is the correct hedge.

items.bewering: Daarom word wasbakke, messe, vurke en baie kombuistoestelle daarvan gemaak.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stainless_steel lists 'cookware, cutlery, surgical instruments, major appliances', and an article image shows stainless steel taps and a sink.

items.bewering: Koper is 'n rooibruin metaal wat elektrisiteit en hitte baie goed gelei.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copper: pure copper is orange-red and tarnishes reddish in air, so 'rooibruin' is an accepted everyday description. Its thermal conductivity is 'second only to silver' among pure metals, and its electrical conductivity is very high.

items.bewering: Daarom is daar koper binne-in baie elektriese drade en kabels.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copper: 'Roughly half of all copper mined is used for electrical wire and cable conductors.'

items.bewering: Koper word ook gebruik om waterpype te maak.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copper: roofing and plumbing take about 20% of copper, and the article discusses copper tubing in plumbing systems. The 1987 US Minerals Yearbook lists plumbing tube among copper's main products (https://search.library.wisc.edu/digital/APCUAWIWNUXSEF9A/text/A7PYCMP4Q6ZKP28Y).

items.bewering: mineraal: 'n Natuurlike, nie-lewende vaste stof in die gesteentes van die aardkors, maar nie steenkool nie.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mineral: a mineral is a naturally occurring solid that forms through geological processes, and biogenic compounds are excluded. Coal is 'a sedimentary rock composed primarily of organically derived carbon', so it is a rock and not a mineral, and the explicit exclusion is correct. 'Nie-lewende' is an acceptable Grade 5 stand-in for 'inorganic'. The entry does not mention a definite composition or crystal structure, which is a simplification but not a falsehood.

items.bewering: gesteente: Rots: die vaste, natuurlike stof waaruit die aardkors bestaan.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mineral: a rock is 'an aggregate of one or more minerals or mineraloids', and the crust is made of rock. The definition is accurate at Grade 5 level.

items.bewering: gelei: Om elektrisiteit of hitte deur te laat, soos 'n koperdraad doen.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copper: copper conducts both heat and electricity, so the example fits the definition.

items.bewering: uitlaatgasse: Die gasse wat 'n enjin uitblaas, soos by 'n motor se uitlaatpyp.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Platinum: in vehicle emissions control, exhaust gas is the gas leaving the engine through the exhaust system. This is a standard definition.

items.bewering: ystererts: 'n Soort klip uit die grond waarin yster vassit.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iron_ore: iron ore is rock rich in iron oxides (hematite, magnetite) from which iron can be extracted. 'Vassit' is acceptable: the iron is chemically bound and has to be freed by smelting. The wording does not say that lumps of metal are embedded.

items.bewering: staal: 'n Sterk metaal wat van yster met 'n klein hoeveelheid ander stowwe gemaak word.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steel: iron alloyed with carbon, 0.02-2.14% in plain carbon steel. The definition is true of steel in general.

items.bewering: vlekvrye staal: Staal waarby chroom gevoeg is sodat dit nie maklik roes nie.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stainless_steel: at least 10.5% chromium, which gives corrosion resistance.

opsomming: One claim needs fixing. The opening calls all eight minerals 'agt van die belangrikste' that South Africa mines, but silver (about 59 t a year, only a by-product) and, more weakly, copper are not among the country's most important mining products. Soften that sentence. Every use and property in the other blocks and glossary entries checks out, and the lesson has no analogies whose mapping could mislead.
